scope: 59 previously exposed annual calendars at proxy points; no new holdout, API request or institutional endorsement.
units: All errors and within-one comparisons use absolute UTC-minute differences, without modulo-day folding.
sourceDateCaveat: Conditional evening-cycle Isha ownership is an unverified interpretation. Literal printed-date comparison retained.

plan.scope: One unfitted astronomical component substitution, previously untested in the inspected studies. All source observations already exposed.

candidate.center: Use complete NOAA calcSunEqOfCenter(t), including NOAA mean anomaly, at the selected UTC00 ephemeris date. All source coefficients unchanged.
candidate.rest: Retain USNO mean longitude, obliquity, atan2 right ascension and EOT=q/15−RA; retain all civil-date regional rules and minute rounding. This is an explicitly hybrid experimental approximation, not a published end-to-end NOAA or Diyanet procedure.

plan.motivation: A secular equation-of-center term could generate an annual timing shape of the order seen in the prior noon inverse diagnostic. No prior fitted coefficient is used in this candidate; similarity is motivation, not validation.
controls: Preserve comparisons under printed-date and conditional evening-cycle Isha interpretations
prohibited: No city or prayer correction chosen from source residuals
No angle, seasonal, coordinate, timezone, rounding, or Temkin changes
No extra coefficient variants after scoring
gate: Strict raw arithmetic validation with an independent expression
Higher aggregate exact agreement with no city-event aggregate exact orwithin-one loss
No additional unavailable predictions or unexplained date changes
plan.ifRejected: Do not change public calendar defaults or disguise proxy/fit agreement as production equivalence. Preserve negative result and explain mechanism.
plan.optionalDiagnostic: If useful, compare noon shape after separately profiled training2026 cityconstant, with identical previous12citysplit and 2027evaluation. Constants remain diagnostic and are never runtimepresets.

forecastFreeze.scope: Forecast written before this candidate scoring; existing known source corpus, not fresh holdout.

source.isolation: Only the three named source definitions evaluated in a Node VM with Math; browser globals and surrounding application code were not loaded.
